summary: Gorax performs 300 pulls on the Option Summons banner on a fresh celebration account. He reviews several legendary heroes pulled along the way, including Tharivol, Durango, Vicana, Twitch, Urgoula, and Tamar. He discusses optimal team archetypes for Dauntless single-target and Toxin damage, while advising players on banner pity strategies and spending efficiency.

heroes.name: Tharivol
heroes.note: Serves as an essential enabler when Curvida is unavailable by boosting basic attack frequency to support Guinavivre.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Crucial for Dauntless team survivability and damage output.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.verdict: Strong Toxin enabler and secondary tank
heroes.note: Applies frequent Toxin and Defense Down while gaining ultimate energy on critical hits to trigger Serpentemis's passive.

heroes.name: Vicana
heroes.note: Functions as a budget version of Serpentemis that relies on her ultimate to apply Toxin, making her rarely used in current metas.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Top-tier Toxin applier when paired with Mystic Conch and Boomerang artifact.

heroes.name: Urgoula
heroes.verdict: Solid PvE tank and control hero
heroes.note: Provides strong survivability with shields, AoE stuns, Attack Penalty, and team cleanses for content like Fey Meander.

heroes.name: Tamar
heroes.note: Excels in Arena by inflicting Buff Prohibition to counter immortality teams, along with stuns and buff dispels.

teams.note: Early-to-mid Dauntless single-target team setup before acquiring Curvida.
Synergistic Toxin team relying on rapid poison application, defense reduction, and tank utility.

meta_changes: Dauntless single-target damage teams and Toxin teams remain top meta options for bossing and AoE content.
tips: Always commit to reaching banner milestones (such as 270 or 300 summons) to claim guaranteed choice heroes rather than stopping halfway.
For low spenders and F2P players, focus on building teams around heroes you enjoy or cheaper functional archetypes like Ice Blast or Aura rather than chasing top-tier meta exclusives.
Build Durango with high Crit Rate to maximize ultimate energy gains and maintain constant Toxin and Defense Down uptime.
title: 300 Dice Into Option Summons 1… Unlucky Again?! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
